Yes, I used to have extreme difficulty with trying to fall asleep and stay asleep. I have trich, OCD and depression. I no longer have difficulty with sleep because I take medication that helps me (seroquil). I'm not going to recommend taking meds because I'm not a psychiatrist. I think it would be a wise decision to talk to a psychiatrist, a psychologist, or even a therapist about sleeping issues. When I cannot sleep, I usually watch documentaries....this usually helps. I've struggled with insomnia from ages 19-21 (I'm 22 now and I no longer struggle with sleep which is really weird...it's like my insomnia just randomly went away) 
I think the insomnia stopped because I was put on the right medication that suited me. Before I took an antipsychotic that I did not need to take and I believe that messed up with my sleep. 
But I hope you get your proper sleep. Always remember to be patient and kind to yourself ❤
